mechanism: Both drugs have CNS depressant effects and can cause orthostatic hypotension; haloperidol may potentiate clonidine's antihypertensive and sedative effects while clonidine withdrawal risk increases with haloperidol co-administration.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for excessive sedation and orthostatic hypotension; ensure gradual titration and avoid abrupt clonidine discontinuation due to rebound hypertension risk.
